scope: Read-only validation of retained G02 high clean6 receipts; no run, build, source change, or independent scene parity claim.

comparability.launchAndChildEnvironment: Only BAR_NATIVE_GROUND_DECAL_UPLOAD_G02 differs between A and B after run-private paths are excluded; G01 remains enabled and its PROBE stays 0.
comparability.traceValidationAndProbe: Frame trace 0, G01 PROBE 0, Grass PROBE 0, Metal debug and shader validation 0 in every launch/child environment.
comparability.qualityAndLimiter: All six runtime Ultra receipts pass, main sample count 1, view 1512x950, VSync/VSyncGame/LimitIdleFps 0.
comparability.sampleWindow: Each RESULT/RUNS record retains 40 contiguous unpaused 30-simulation bins from 540 through 1740. LAUNCH.measurementWindow still says 600 through 1800 and must not be used as the actual counted window.
comparability.retirementAndCleanup: Six normal exits, owned groups gone, one Retired world marker per engine log, observer issue lists empty, private widget/overlay removed; owner batch CLOSED and awake owner released.
comparability.readiness: PREPARED.json records READY_NO_GAME and six staged arms; there is no separately named CLEAN-READY file in this suite.
comparability.selection: High clean6 was selected before execution. Low clean6 was not selected because the low functional receipt had Prepare=0.

arithmetic.source: RUNS.json/RESULT.json, six valid retained runs; arithmetic matches COMPLETION.json

limits: FPS is host-observed in this exact scene and window; no isolated GPU-cost or visual-equivalence inference.
The clean batch uses PROBE=0, so it does not independently show indexed or packed route counts; the separate functional receipt supplies route evidence.
Normal exit supports retirement observation; abrupt process termination behavior is outside this receipt.
